/-! ## Symbolic TV expression-size budget (W3-C1b)

`EqSat.gateDeclWithSymbolicTV`, `LoopVectorizeOpt.loopVectorizeOptPass`) skip validation and

a *passed* TV result as sufficient for a `.translationValidated` branch, never as necessary, so
skipping the gate can only lose an optimization, never soundness. Calibrated on

/-- Peak estimated symbolic-expression tree size accepted by the SymbolicTV gates. -/
def symTvMaxExprNodes : Nat := 65536

/-- Walk-fuel budget for `estCodeNodesWalk`: total `seqFor` step-body walks across nesting. -/

private def symTvSatAdd (a b : Nat) : Nat := Nat.min symTvSizeCap (a + b)

private def symTvSzAt (sizes : Array Nat) (v : VarId) : Nat :=
  if h : v < sizes.size then sizes[v] else 1

/-- Bind `v ↦ sz` in `sizes`, growing the backing array lazily on first sight of `v`. -/
private def symTvSetSz (sizes : Array Nat) (v : VarId) (sz : Nat) : Array Nat :=
  if v < sizes.size then sizes.setIfInBounds v sz
  else sizes ++ (Array.replicate (v - sizes.size) 1) |>.push sz

    matching the executor's unshared expansion; saturating at `symTvSizeCap`). -/
